blocks.explanation:
Yeh partial fractions ka sawal hai jis ke denominator mein ek irreducible quadratic factor \(x^2 + 1\) aur ek linear factor \(x + 3\) hai, yani Case III.
Find kya karna hai? Woh constants jin se diya gaya fraction chhote, aasaan fractions ka jama ban jaye.
Plan: pehle shakal likhenge, denominators hata kar identity banayenge, \(x = -3\) rakh kar \(C\) nikalenge, phir coefficients compare kar ke \(A\) aur \(B\).
Aakhir mein fractions ko wapas jor kar tasdeeq karenge ke asal fraction hi wapas aata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{9x - 7}{(x^2 + 1)(x + 3)}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke fraction proper hai ya nahi. Top ki degree 1 aur bottom ki degree \(2 + 1 = 3\) hai, is liye proper hai, division ki zaroorat nahi. Ab factors dekhte hain: \(x^2 + 1 = 0\) ka matlab \(x^2 = -1\), jo kisi real number ke liye mumkin nahi, is liye \(x^2 + 1\) irreducible (na tootne wala) quadratic factor hai. Yeh Case III hai: quadratic ke upar \(Ax + B\), linear factor \(x + 3\) ke upar \(C\). \(C\) ko \(x = -3\) rakh kar aur \(A\), \(B\) ko coefficients compare kar ke nikalenge.

Partial fractions ki shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{9x - 7}{(x^2 + 1)(x + 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{Ax + B}{x^2 + 1} + \dfrac{C}{x + 3}\]
Kyun: Jo quadratic factor toot nahi sakta (irreducible), us ke upar hamesha ek power kam wala linear numerator \(Ax + B\) aata hai. Linear factor \(x + 3\) ke upar sirf ek constant \(C\) aata hai. Agar hum \(x^2 + 1\) ke upar sirf \(A\) likhein to har fraction ka jawab nahi ban sakta, is liye \(Ax + B\) zaroori hai.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[9x - 7 = (Ax + B)(x + 3)\]
\[+ C(x^2 + 1) \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x^2 + 1)(x + 3)\) se multiply kiya. Har fraction ka apna factor cancel ho jata hai aur baqi factor numerator ke saath reh jata hai: \(Ax + B\) ke saath \(x + 3\), aur \(C\) ke saath \(x^2 + 1\). Yeh identity (har value par sach) hai, conditional equation nahi; is liye hum \(x\) ki koi bhi value rakh sakte hain aur coefficients bhi compare kar sakte hain.

\(C\) ke liye (i) mein \(x = -3\) rakhein
\[9(-3) - 7 = 0 + C(9 + 1)\]
\[-34 = 10C\]
\[C = -\dfrac{17}{5}\]
Kyun: \(x = -3\) rakhne se \(x + 3 = 0\) ho jata hai, is liye \((Ax + B)(x + 3)\) wala poora term zero ho jata hai aur sirf \(C\) bachta hai. Yeh sab se tez tareeqa hai: ek hi line mein ek constant mil gaya.
Dhyan dein: \((-3)^2 = +9\) hai, is liye \(x^2 + 1 = 10\) bana; yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

(i) ki right side kholein aur powers ikatthi karein
\[(Ax + B)(x + 3)\]
\[= Ax^2 + 3Ax + Bx + 3B\]
\[C(x^2 + 1) = Cx^2 + C\]
\[9x - 7 = (A + C)x^2\]
\[+ (3A + B)x + (3B + C)\]
Kyun: \(A\) aur \(B\) ab \(x = -3\) jaisi kisi value se seedhe nahi milte, kyunke \(x^2 + 1\) kabhi zero nahi hota. Is liye brackets khol kar \(x^2\), \(x\) aur constant ko alag alag ikattha kiya, taake dono sides ke coefficients compare ho sakein.

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ 0 = A + C\]
\[A = -C = \dfrac{17}{5}\]
\[\text{const}:\ -7 = 3B + C\]
\[3B = -7 + \dfrac{17}{5} = -\dfrac{18}{5}\]
\[B = -\dfrac{6}{5}\]
Kyun: Do polynomials tabhi har \(x\) par barabar hote hain jab har power ka coefficient barabar ho (yeh book ka theorem on equal polynomials hai). Left side \(9x - 7\) mein \(x^2\) hai hi nahi, is liye us ka coefficient 0 likha. Constant compare karne mein \(C = -17/5\) rakha, to \(-7 + 17/5 = -35/5 + 17/5 = -18/5\) bana.
Dhyan dein: \(x^2\) ka coefficient 0 likhna bhool jana aam ghalti hai.

\(x\) ke coefficient se parakh
\[3A + B = \dfrac{51}{5} - \dfrac{6}{5}\]
\[= \dfrac{45}{5} = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Yeh equation humne constants nikalne mein istemal nahi ki, is liye yeh ek azaad (independent) test hai. Left side par \(9x\) hai aur right side bhi 9 de rahi hai, matlab \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) teeno sahi hain.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{Ax + B}{x^2 + 1} = \dfrac{17x - 6}{5(x^2 + 1)}\]
\[\dfrac{C}{x + 3} = -\dfrac{17}{5(x + 3)}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{17}{5}x - \frac{6}{5}\) dono ka denominator 5 hai, is liye 5 ko neeche le gaye: \(\frac{17x - 6}{5}\). Is tarah fractions ke andar fractions nahi rehte aur jawab saaf nazar aata hai.

Tasdeeq: fractions ko wapas jorein
Common denominator \(5(x^2 + 1)(x + 3)\); top:
\[(17x - 6)(x + 3)\]
\[= 17x^2 + 45x - 18\]
\[17(x^2 + 1) = 17x^2 + 17\]
\[\text{Top} = 45x - 35\]
\[= 5(9x - 7) \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Common denominator \(5(x^2 + 1)(x + 3)\) liya. Pehle fraction ka top \((x + 3)\) se aur doosre ka \((x^2 + 1)\) se multiply hua, phir minus kiya. Top \(5(9x - 7)\) aaya; 5 cancel karne se bilkul asal fraction wapas mil gaya, is liye jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(\frac{9x - 7}{(x^2 + 1)(x + 3)} = \frac{17x - 6}{5(x^2 + 1)} - \frac{17}{5(x + 3)}\)
Yeh book ki answer key ke jawab se bilkul milta hai.
